# Aguilar Beauty & Products

> Family hair salon based in Round Rock, Texas. A family neighborhood salon in Round Rock: haircuts for women, men and kids, fades with freehand designs, color, highlights, beard trims and eyebrows, plus shelves of natural products, herbal teas and vitamins. Se habla español.

- Google rating: 4.6 from 175 reviews

## Services
- Family haircuts: Cuts for men, women and kids, with patient stylists who take their time, even with the little ones.
- Hair designs: Greek keys, crosses, curves and line art, cut freehand into a clean fade or a nape undercut.
- Color & highlights: Rich all-over color, highlights and bold accents like burgundy and magenta.
- Beard trims & shaves: Beard trims, shaping and straight-razor shaves to finish off your cut.
- Treatments & brows: Hair treatments, straightening and styling for a night out, plus eyebrow shaping while you are in the chair.
- Productos: Styling gels, herbal teas, vitamins and natural remedies on our shelves.

## About
Aguilar Beauty & Products is a family neighborhood salon on N Mays St in Round Rock, in a bright room with lilac walls, black mirror stations, haircut-chart posters and a row of leather chairs for whoever is waiting their turn. Kids, parents and grandparents all come through the same door. Clients mention stylists who are patient, who listen, and who send them home loving how their hair came out, at a fair price. It is more than a salon: the window reads Aguilar Beauty & Natural Products, and the shelves are stocked with styling gels, herbal teas, vitamins and natural remedies, each labeled by hand in Spanish. Se habla español.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Walk-ins and appointments are both welcome. It can get busy, so call (512) 300-0312 to book a time or check the wait.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts are a big part of what we do, from simple trims to fades with a design.
- Q: Do you do eyebrows and hair treatments?
  A: Yes. Along with cuts and color, we do eyebrows, hair treatments and hair styles. Call (512) 300-0312 to ask about yours.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. Se habla español, and our price list and product signs are in Spanish.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM and Sunday 10 AM to 5 PM. Holiday hours can differ, so call to check.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2021 N Mays St, Unit 1100, Round Rock, TX 78664.
- Q: What products do you sell?
  A: Styling gels like Johnny B Mode, plus herbal teas, vitamins and natural remedies. Stop in and ask what is on the shelf.
